title: Daily Ad Revenue per Game Region
prompt: You manage a free-to-play mobile game with multiple geographic regions. Marketing wants a daily revenue report for a fixed 7-day period (2024-06-01 through 2024-06-07, inclusive) for each region. Some region-day combinations had no ad impressions at all, but the report must still show those days with 0 revenue so analysts can spot quiet periods. Write a query that generates all (region_id, report_date) combinations for the 7-day window, then LEFT JOINs the actual ad_impressions to compute total revenue per region-day. Output columns: `region_id`, `report_date`, `total_revenue` (use COALESCE so days with no impressions show 0.00, not NULL). Order by region_id ascending, then report_date ascending.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE regions (region_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_name VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE ad_impressions (impression_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, region_id INT, impression_date DATE, revenue_cents INT);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO regions (region_id, region_name) VALUES (1, 'North America'), (2, 'Europe'); INSERT INTO ad_impressions (region_id, impression_date, revenue_cents) VALUES (1, '2024-06-01', 120), (1, '2024-06-01', 80), (1, '2024-06-03', 150), (2, '2024-06-02', 200), (2, '2024-06-07', 90);

composite_moves: CROSS JOIN skeleton with regions to produce all (region, date) pairs
LEFT JOIN actual ad_impressions on region_id and impression_date
SUM revenue_cents and divide by 100 for dollars

hints: You need every combination of region and date, even when no impressions occurred that day.
Use generate_series to build the 7-day skeleton, then CROSS JOIN it with the regions table to get all (region, date) pairs.
LEFT JOIN the ad_impressions table on matching region_id and impression_date, then SUM the revenue_cents (converting to dollars) and COALESCE any NULLs to 0.00.
answer_key: WITH date_skeleton AS (SELECT generate_series(DATE '2024-06-01', DATE '2024-06-07', INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS report_date), region_date_combos AS (SELECT r.region_id, d.report_date FROM regions r CROSS JOIN date_skeleton d) SELECT rc.region_id, rc.report_date, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(a.revenue_cents) / 100.0, 2), 0.00) AS total_revenue FROM region_date_combos rc LEFT JOIN ad_impressions a ON rc.region_id = a.region_id AND rc.report_date = a.impression_date GROUP BY rc.region_id, rc.report_date ORDER BY rc.region_id, rc.report_date;

_meta.scenario: a free-to-play mobile game tracking session length and ad impressions
